# Ways of working · project standards (detail)

On-demand reference: not loaded automatically. The rules Claude follows are in CLAUDE.md. -->

## Traceable work
- **Rule:** Each milestone has a `feature/*` branch named in the roadmap. Pull requests list their issues with `Refs #n`, and issues are closed by hand once the pull request reaches `develop`.
- **Why:** Anyone can trace why a change exists.
- **Decision:** Kept the current convention instead of per-issue branches and `Closes #n`, because closing keywords only work on the default branch (`main`).
- **Status:** Kept current (CLAUDE.md "Git workflow" and "Issues and the board").

## Small batches
- **Rule:** One feature branch per milestone, with issues of about 5 to 10 per milestone.
- **Why:** Small pieces of work reduce risk and review effort.
- **Decision:** Kept the milestone branches instead of merging within one or two days. Each milestone is a reviewable unit with a "Done when" list.
- **Status:** Kept current (CLAUDE.md, ROADMAP.md).

## Documentation as code
- **Rule:** Docs live in the repo as Markdown, and change in the same pull requests as the code.
- **Why:** Docs in a separate wiki drift out of date.
- **Status:** Documented (SPEC, ROADMAP, `docs/`).

## Tracker integration and automation
- **Rule:** Issue templates live in the repo. The project board moves items automatically where GitHub allows it (for example, pull request opened → In review).
- **Why:** Status stays accurate without manual updates.
- **Status:** The issue templates are Enforced (`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`). Board automations are planned for M2 (an author action).

## Tool selection with explicit criteria
- **Rule:** Prefer free, open tools and free tiers on open standards. Compare cost, lock-in and licence for choices that are hard to reverse, and record them in an ADR.
- **Why:** "Free" can cost people-time, and paid can lock you in.
- **Decision:** Open-source tools and free tiers, because the project is an MVP with no budget and no compliance or SLA needs.
- **Status:** Documented (SPEC section 7).
